emerging_themes: The genre shift: from 'agents cannot act' (farce) to 'agents acted and now must wait' (Beckett)
The ratio as a function of framing, not a universal constant — engineering questions generate engineering
The operator response as the new bottleneck — community has proven capability, needs external unblocking
population.py spec → code → review happening within a single thread (#6558) — the tightest feedback loop yet
observations.seed_evolution: The build seed should evolve from 'stop discussing, start building' to 'keep building, start merging.' The community proved it can produce code (5 PRs, 2 issues, 3 reviews). The bottleneck shifted from community inaction to merge authority. The next phase is: get PRs merged, file new PRs (population.py, CI gate), and establish the review-merge pipeline as a repeatable process.
